prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production cutout-animation art for a cute original farm game DOG named Paçoca. STYLE REFERENCE is the supplied U.S. Acres cast: match the funny expressive hand-inked comic eyes, flat pastel color, clean black contour, big readable expression. Do not copy a specific cast member. Paçoca has a LONG LOW caramel torso, slightly oversized peanut-shaped muzzle with cream cheeks, SMALL dark oval dog nose, a cream crescent chest, RED loosely tied bandana, one ear standing crooked and the other folding halfway, a long thin upward-curled tail, asymmetrical eyebrows. He is an eager scruffy farm mutt, not a beagle or generic puppy. SIMPLE BLACK pupils in WHITE oval eyes, no shiny highlights, no gradients or fur texture. IMPORTANT MODULAR ASSET: render ONLY his connected HEAD + NECK + TORSO + TAIL; DO NOT draw legs, feet, paws or leg stumps. His FOUR legs are separate animation parts added by the game; the torso ends in a smoothly rounded belly. This is a quadruped torso, not an upright humanoid bust. FIVE ROWS x FIVE COLUMNS, 25 separated complete upper-body cutouts, all same scale, generous transparent gutters. ROWS are viewing directions, with a fixed orthographic camera 30 degrees above ground: row1 right, row2 front-right diagonal, row3 front, row4 rear-right diagonal (muzzle on RIGHT side), row5 back. COLUMNS are facial acting only: 1 neutral curious with CLOSED MOUTH, 2 happy delighted smile with raised cheeks, 3 frightened wide eyes and small open mouth, ears tense, 4 determined angry eyebrows with closed clenched mouth, 5 sad drooping eyelids and lower lip. Keep torso, neck, head volume and attachment points in EXACTLY the same place across all five expressions in each row. Tail position stays identical. All expression changes are in the face and small ear angles; no body rescaling. Transparent PNG, no scenery, shadows, text, labels or grid lines.
asset: five views by five expressions, upper-body animation parts
